description.narrative: The MFA supports activities that inform and engage the Danish public in international development cooperation and the global South. The media reelly will inform and engage Danes between 13-29 in the Global South and Danish development cooperation through journalistic social media productions, educational materials, events and partnerships.

reelly is an independent media outlet that produces and publishes quality journalism on global development and living conditions in so-called DAC countries, which are on the OECD's list of developing countries, and Denmark's role in this. reelly primarily targets 18-29-year-olds who are neutral in the so-called yellow segment, according to Advice's segment analysis. reelly is primarily published on Instagram and TikTok. The goal is to make the target group more knowledgeable about and engaged in global development and development issues by informing, breaking down stereotypes, and challenging prejudices through surprising stories with perspectives that build bridges to the lives of young Danes.
